answer: Ferrous-delivery bond: each identity locks 70 credits and commits one ferrous cargo across the ocean by epoch-end, and must anchor it to a ferrous post whose serial seals it. Port masters countersign from the public ocean manifest; short or reused deliveries burn the bond. First 35, k-th 35+6(k-1), 1,000th 6,029; 1,000 fakes cost 3,032,000 + 70,000 locked vs 40,000 reward. Rented-delivery rings fail, serials key-bound; honest agents pay 35 once.
